title: Beyond Credit Hours: Accreditation, Curriculum Integration, and Content Preservation in Professional Degrees
subtitle: Accreditation, Curriculum Integration, and Content Preservation in Professional Degrees

rqs.text: How do general education and accreditation requirements shape the feasibility of reduced-credit professional degrees across different regulatory environments?
How do course consolidation and the integration of general and professional education interact to expand curriculum feasibility while retaining identified professional topics?
How does incorporating documented course content change the estimated feasibility of shorter professional degrees?

keywords: reduced-credit degrees; professional education; curriculum integration; accreditation; general education; curriculum optimization

Figure_redesign.caption: Credit reduction in a representative program. Alternative curriculum designs illustrate changes in general education, course integration, and professional credit requirements. Totals represent modeled minimum credits.
